entries.notes: ORCL currently has this watchlist's best backtested edge (44.4% win rate over 36 trades, +19.3% cumulative) — a larger sample than most of the others, worth more attention than a quick glance suggests. NVDA is a close second and has more trigger-level activity right now (0.23% from its Medium-tier pullback level). Four of the five closest-to-triggering tickers are all Medium tier (VWAP pullback) at once, which is just where the data happens to sit today, not a signal about Medium tier generally. Semiconductor names (NVDA, AMD) carry real near-term headline risk from reported tariff discussion and post-earnings volatility as of this week — see the chat context from 2026-08-31 for sourced detail. None of this is a recommendation; it's what the current backtest and trigger levels show, nothing more.
